title: DongCheng Electric Circular Saw 7" | 1100W | 0-45° | Adjustable Bevel | 64mm Cutting Capacity | With Included Accesories & Company Original TCT Wood Cutting Blade Included | DMY02-185 | Heavy Duty |
description: The DongCheng DMY02-185 Electric Circular Saw is a hot-selling professional power tool designed for those who demand precision and efficiency on the job. Powered by a robust 1100W motor, this saw delivers high-efficiency cutting with a no-load speed of 5600 RPM, making it ideal for a wide range of woodworking and construction tasks. Weighing just 3.6kg, it is remarkably light-weight and comfortable to operate for extended periods. The adjustable bevel cutting angle of 0-45° allows you to meet diverse cutting requirements with ease, while the large cutting capacity of 64mm at 0° and 42mm at 45° ensures versatility across projects. The compact aluminium alloy guard design offers a perfect balance of weight and durability. A double handle provides a labour-saving and highly efficient grip, and the large dust outlet ensures smooth discharging during operation. The 185mm TCT wood cutting blade (Ø180×1.8×25.4×60T, max. 7500R/min) is included with the saw, so you can get started right away. A reliable choice for both professionals and serious DIY enthusiasts.
